notes.title: Core Breach Next Fest Developer Stream
notes.notes: Come and join me while I play Core Breach and tell you a little bit more about the game while I try to beat everyone's high scores!

notes.title: Steam Page Up!
notes.notes:
The Core Breach page has been accepted and is now visible on the Steam store!!

How exciting! My very first Steam game release is now visible on the Steam store. I've been using Steam for 17 years! I've wanted to create games for so long, and today marks the day I am one step closer to a dream I've had since my early teenage years.

Now the workload has just been increased another level! Time to get my game in front of as many eyes as possible!
